title: 第1167章 天才画家登上热搜第1166章 众叛亲离周德胜
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
这一个超级大刹车差点把林默都晃晕过去。
而这时候，夏灵突然长舒一口气笑道：「哦，突然想起来有红灯也没事，因为我没有驾照，没有驾照为什么要怕闯红灯呀。」
「嗯？！！」
林默瞬间扭头看着夏灵，眼睛瞪的老大。
「诶？老大你这样看着我干嘛？」夏灵往旁边一缩，意识到什么大笑了起来：「没有没有，我开玩笑的，我怎么可能没驾照！老大你也太小瞧我了！」
林默听闻一脸无语。
随后叹了一口气，现在能让自己心情起伏如此之大的恐怕也就只有夏灵了。
「对了老大，什么情况，让你突然说话？」
「你看群里就知道了。」
夏灵立马启动车，停在了路边的车位后才拿出手机查看了聊天记录。
林默又详细解说了一遍。
「哦！」夏灵这才惊奇道：「那这个周德胜的情况还是第一次见到嘞！」
林默点头：「所以你有什么好办法让他与我们合作吗？」
因为周德胜的情况的确特殊，林默一时间没想到确切的办法，所以就随口一问。
夏灵努努嘴：「这个简单呀，周德胜不是跟君富所有人都有仇嘛，那直接告诉他，只要与我们合作，就把君富扳倒，让所有人失业，他肯定很乐意的。」
林默听闻，眉毛一挑：「有道理啊！」
林默拍了拍脑门，这么简单的道理自己怎么没想到呢？
周德胜是君富的敌人，自己也是君富的敌人，那敌人的敌人就是自己的朋友。
这个道理很简单啊！
是不是最近超频用脑了？

怎么这都没想到？
确实，林默觉得最近思考是有点过度了。
夏灵这时候继续说道：「可是周德胜的想法是让君富所有人失业诶，我们不能这么干吧。」
林默微微一笑：「我们当然要让君富的员工全部失业，但又没说不让他们再就业。」
「诶嘿！」夏灵听闻，露出了惊喜脸。
「好了回律师吧，我好好想想。」
「好嘞！」
夏灵踩下油门。
回到律所后，林默走进办公室关上门开始仔细思考，有了战略就得思考计划了，话术是很重要的。
时间过的很快，一下子就到了晚上。
>>
林默走出办公室去大楼的食堂吃饭，坐下后打开手机，最近新闻热点弹了出来。
content_en:
This super big brake almost knocked Lin Mo unconscious.
At this time, Xia Ling suddenly breathed a sigh of relief and said with a smile: "Oh, I suddenly remembered that it's okay if there is a red light, because I don't have a driver's license. Why should I be afraid of running a red light without a driver's license?"
"Huh?!!"
Lin Mo instantly turned to look at Xia Ling, his eyes widened.
"Eh? Why are you looking at me like this, boss?"
Lin Mo was speechless when he heard this.
Then he sighed. Xia Ling was probably the only one who could make his mood fluctuate so much now.
"By the way, boss, what's the situation that made you speak suddenly?"
"You can tell just by looking at the group."
Xia Ling immediately started the car and parked in a parking space on the side of the road before taking out her mobile phone and checking the chat history.
Lin Mo explained in detail again.
"Oh!" Xia Ling said in surprise: "Then this is the first time I've seen Zhou Desheng's situation!"
Lin Mo nodded: "So do you have any good way to get him to cooperate with us?"
Because Zhou Desheng's situation was indeed special, Lin Mo couldn't think of an exact solution for a while, so he asked casually.
Xia Ling pursed her lips: "It's simple. Zhou Desheng doesn't have a grudge against everyone in Junfu. Then tell him directly that as long as he cooperates with us, he will bring down Junfu and make everyone lose their jobs. He will definitely be happy."
Lin Mo heard this and raised his eyebrows: "That makes sense!"
Lin Mo patted his forehead, why didn't he think of such a simple truth?
Zhou Desheng is Jun Fu's enemy, and he is Jun Fu's enemy. The enemy of his enemy is his friend.
The truth is very simple!
Have you overclocked your brain recently?
Why didn't you think of this?
Indeed, Lin Mo feels that he has been thinking too much recently.
Xia Ling continued: "But Zhou Desheng's idea is to make everyone in Junfu lose their jobs. We can't do that."
Lin Mo smiled slightly: "Of course we will make all Junfu employees lose their jobs, but we didn't say we won't let them find jobs again."
"Hey!" Xia Ling showed surprise when she heard this.
"Okay, let's go back to the lawyer. I'll think about it."
"Okay!"
Xia Ling stepped on the accelerator.
After returning to the law firm, Lin Mo walked into the office, closed the door, and began to think carefully. Once you have a strategy, you have to think about a plan. Speaking skills is very important.
Time passed quickly, and it was night in no time.
>>
Lin Mo walked out of the office and went to the building's cafeteria to eat. After sitting down, he turned on his phone and the latest news hot spots popped up.
